scenes.hook: An image can contain a watermark you cannot see. A detector may still be able to find it.
scenes.idea: Tools such as Synth I D embed signals in supported A I generated content to help identify its origin.
scenes.demo: The signal is part of the content, rather than just a visible logo placed in a corner.
scenes.compare: A detected watermark can support an origin claim. It does not prove that the scene or message is true.
scenes.takeaway: And no detected mark does not prove a human made the file. Check sources and context too.
scenes.close: What would you verify before sharing? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
